name: Fam. Banzer
beschreibung:
In the picturesque village of Tannheim, the Banzer family welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean care and a cosy alpine ambiance. Pleasantly furnished rooms invite relaxation after active days exploring the mountains.

Scenic hiking trails, Lake Vilsalpsee, cable cars, and cross-country tracks are easily accessible, making this an ideal year-round holiday base.
kurzbeschreibung: Accommodation Fam. Banzer in Tannheim offers heartfelt family hospitality and cosy rooms in the scenic Tannheimer Tal.
